fields.summary_ko.0: Texas Instruments (TXN) is rated with an average broker recommendation (ABR) of 1.93 across 33 securities firms (between Strong Buy and Buy), with 57.6% (19 firms) recommending Strong Buy.
fields.summary_ko.1: Broker recommendations show strong positive bias, with a 5-to-1 ratio of Strong Buy to Strong Sell recommendations, which may not align with retail investor interests.
fields.summary_ko.2: Using both quantitative models based on earnings estimate revisions such as Zacks Rank and ABR together is a more effective approach for profitable investment decisions.
